headline: Mexican Peso Weakens Past 19 Per Dollar as Banxico Flags Inflation Risks
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated to 19.06 per US dollar, its weakest since June 2025. Banxico minutes highlighted wage increases and El Niño weather patterns as risks delaying its 3% inflation target to late 2027.
why: The Mexican peso is the most liquid currency in Latin America; Banxico's interest rate stance directly influences local sovereign yields and carry trades.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: The peso weakened beyond 19 per dollar on expectations of prolonged Banxico pauses and persistent inflation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Traders sold the peso as Banxico board members raised inflation concerns and markets weighed potential interest rate divergence with the US.
